name: Bart
source:
A floor observer at the casino, he's a freewheeling man that you can't seem to get a grip on.
He doesn't care about things that don't interest him.
He has a dangerous thrill seeking personality and is always getting into noisy troubles with women.
He has fun teasing the protagonist.
